how: One table of reading traps, read by the place words (places.py), the concept words (cluster.py) and the flag words (watch.py). A phrase is rewritten to its true reading before any word is looked up. A bare word is not enough to put an event in a place or in 'domestic' (CONTRACT 20.4).

phrases.note: 米国の中間選挙。「米中」は米国と中国の意味ではない（「米中間の対話」のように間の意味で使う時は「米中間」の後に選が続かない）
